targets.name: Claude Code
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `@` followed by the file path.
targets.newChatGuidance: Open a new terminal and run `claude`, or open a new Claude Code tab in VS Code or a new session in the desktop app

targets.name: Codex CLI
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `@` followed by the file path.
targets.newChatGuidance: Open a new terminal and run `codex`, or start a new chat in the Codex IDE extension or app
targets.postInstallNote: Codex CLI does not support custom slash commands. APM commands are installed as skills and invoked with the $ prefix (e.g., $apm-1-initiate-planner) instead of /slash-commands.

targets.name: Cursor
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `@` and search for the file name.
targets.newChatGuidance: Start a new Agent chat in the Cursor editor, or open a new terminal in the project root and run `agent`

targets.name: GitHub Copilot
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `#file` and select the file from the picker.
targets.newChatGuidance: Start a new chat in the VS Code Chat view, or open a new terminal and run `copilot`

subagentGuidance.toolSyntax: `runSubagent` with `agentName: "Explore"` in VS Code, or `task` with `agent_type: "explore"` in Copilot CLI

targets.name: Antigravity
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `@` followed by the file path.
targets.newChatGuidance: Start a new conversation in the Antigravity app or IDE agent panel, or open a new terminal and run `agy`

targets.name: OpenCode
targets.contextAttachSyntax: Reference the file using `@` followed by the file name.
targets.newChatGuidance: Open a new terminal and run `opencode`, or start a new session in the OpenCode desktop app

subagentGuidance.toolSyntax: `task(subagent_type="explore", description="...", prompt="...")` on OpenCode 1.x, or `subagent(agent="explore", description="...", prompt="...")` on OpenCode 2.x
